question: For the sorted data 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 12, 14, 15, find the interquartile range (the third quartile minus the first quartile; take the median of the first 4 values and the median of the last 4 values separately).
solution: The median of the lower half, 3, 5, 6, 8, is 5.5. The median of the upper half, 9, 12, 14, 15, is 13. The interquartile range is \(13-5.5=7.5\).
